note: Every live CAP (status Final or Implemented in stellar-protocol core/README.md, retrieved 16 November 2026): the schema cells, named patterns or data probes that show it in ledger data, or why it has no reader-visible shape. tools/cap_coverage.py checks each against the corpus.

caps.title: Transaction level signature verification
caps.no_shape_reason: Changes when signatures are checked; no new XDR. Readers see only the existing result codes.

caps.title: Improved Rounding for Cross Offer
caps.no_shape_reason: Changes how crossed-offer amounts are rounded; no new XDR. The amounts themselves are checked by the replay oracle's balance check.

caps.title: Throttling and transaction pricing improvements
caps.no_shape_reason: Fee and surge-pricing rules; no new XDR (transaction-set fee components came with CAP-0042).
